section_2_ksr_obviousness.reconstruction: EP3806757B1 (sensor→controller→flow) + US11504151B2 (pull force) + US20250186070A1 (clot characterization) + general predictive control → candidate's loop is arguably obvious
what_blocks_full_reconstruction: No reference teaches predicting fragmentation as a future event (all are reactive)
No reference ties adjustment to embolization-prevention via strain-rate reduction
Motivation is generic ('predict something bad'), not specific to fragmentation precursor
section_2_ksr_obviousness.residual_non_obviousness: Lives in exactly 2 places: (a) specific friability-precursor signal being non-obvious, (b) velocity-specific actuation shown non-interchangeable. Both are EMPIRICAL (physics) questions, not legal ones.

section_3_force_flow_velocity_revisited.genuine_distinction: YES at physics level — flow/pressure act on aspiration side (indirect); traction velocity acts directly on clot-bond loading rate (rate-dependent brittle fracture)
section_3_force_flow_velocity_revisited.ce012_trap: NOT a safe harbor at claim-construction level if claims are drafted functionally. A POSITA would regard flow-rate, pressure, and velocity as alternative actuators in the same control space.
section_3_force_flow_velocity_revisited.survival_condition: Claim survives ONLY IF it recites traction-velocity modulation driven specifically by forward-prediction signal from friability precursor — not generic extraction control.

section_5_physics_gate_pre_registration.kill_condition_1_median_lead_time: Measure: time delta between precursor crossing and fragmentation onset. Kill if median <1s.
section_5_physics_gate_pre_registration.kill_condition_2_false_positive_rate: Measure: ROC/PR curve, sensitivity at fixed specificity, FP/hour. Kill if clinically acceptable sensitivity yields unacceptable FP burden.
section_5_physics_gate_pre_registration.kill_condition_3_precursor_disappears_un: Measure: precursor SNR across flow rates, vessel curvatures, pulsatility. Kill if indistinguishable from noise in dominant clinical stratum.
section_5_physics_gate_pre_registration.kill_condition_4_signal_varies_with_devi: Measure: factorial experiment varying motion vs clot state, variance decomposition. Kill if motion explains dominant share of signal variance.
section_5_physics_gate_pre_registration.kill_condition_5_intervention_cannot_exe: Measure: end-to-end actuation latency vs lead-time distribution. Kill if execution probability <80%.
section_5_physics_gate_pre_registration.kill_condition_6_intervention_fails_to_r: Measure: randomized paired comparison (predictive+velocity vs reactive-only vs no control), distal embolic particle count. Kill if no significant reduction attributable to predictive-velocity arm.
